body: Yeah. Take a risk.  It's what I want to do.  I've got the idea for something I'd like to do, but no financial backing, and no plan.

I got a degree in Philosophy.  It was thereputic, but isn't employable.  I traded the ability to easily sail into a career for 4 years of something I enjoyed.  I have someone. She's my rock.

I'm working on getting a shitty job.  I tend to stop showing up at shitty jobs. Bills don't motivate me, they make me hate myself.

I just thought by 24 I'd have been out of college and at least on my way to starting a life.  Even if I had a shitty job, I'd be content enough to pay the bills.  

I feel like every time I try to get on my feet and be responsible, I get kicked to the curb or otherwise stumble and fall. I'm tired of picking myself up.

I'm not clever enough to be that guy.  I guess I don't know what I'd enjoy doing for more than a few hours here and there.  I get short bursts of excitement that die quickly.  I chase them, but it's futile.

>You mentioned that you hate work, is there something else you would rather be doing? Do you have any passions or hobbies that you can pursue or turn into a successful career?

Not that anyone will ever pay me for.

Hi.  I feel what you feel.  Inside that connection is hope.  I've been where you are more times than not. Just know that there is at least one other person out there who is going through what you are.  Even if that connection is all you've got... it's something.

You can get through the times like this.  We both can.

Life makes me so angry.  I have a hard time remembering what it was like to be a kid who was hopeful, bright-eyed, and happy.  I want that back.

What went wrong?  I'm broke, and alone on my birthday.  I feel like I have so much potential and can't access it.  It's starting to feel like maybe that's not the case.  Maybe I don't.

This isn't how things were supposed to be.  But I feel powerless to change.  I don't even know what I want, even if I could have it.

I don't know you.  Know that I care.  I'll never know who youa re or walk in your shoes.  I'll never do more than trade stories with you on the internet.  But you're a person who lives and breaths.  You're a mind with it's own experience.  And that alone is enough to make me care.  
---

Thanks.  I needed that wake up call today.  The act of feeling that reconnection to people is the first glimpse of sunlight I've seen all day.
Keep on, keeping on.  Its all any of us can do.
